desc:
Hide the Boys 👀
Hide all the boys before the seeker finds them! Work fast, pick smart hiding spots, and don’t get caught. Mom's on the hunt, and every second counts! Can you keep all the boys safe until time runs out?

💥 Hide, run, and outsmart the seeker
🧍‍♂️ Place the boys in funny or clever spots
🏆 Win rounds, collect all the boys, and show off your best hiding skills

School Map CC: Duffable

Play with friends, laugh a lot, and see who’s the best hider in Hide the Boys!
